notes:
Top-line: Summit Echo is a mid-market CCaaS analytics vendor that licenses summarization, QA and coaching layers to enterprise contact centers. They want a reliable post-call summary pipeline with coaching highlights and structured QA outputs to push into Salesforce/Zendesk.

Key requirements / quotes from the PO: "We need coachable highlights + verbatim quotes, not just blobs of text. Accuracy matters for QA sampling. Also must survive 8-10x seasonal spikes with predictable cost."

Technical details: prefer VPC/private deployment for EU enterprise customers; pilot used hosted API for speed but legal pushing for on-prem/VPC for data residency. POC ingested 1.2M minutes (recordings + transcripts), Redwood hosted API returned structured summaries and QA rubric scores. Observed bottleneck during synthetic spike test (concurrent batch job to process day-of-holiday backlog) — request routing and burst capacity discussion pending.

Quality notes: Summaries hit target QA rubric (relevance, actionability) ~82% per SE evaluation. Coach highlights extraction pulled top 3 coaching opportunities and timestamps; customers liked timestamped quotes for training. Missed contextual references for multi-party calls ~12% of cases.

Integrations: Must export to Salesforce case fields, create/update Zendesk tickets, and store transcripts in S3 with KMS encryption. Also want function/tool-calling to run downstream ticket creation automatically.

Business: They resell analytics to contact centers and want to offer a "summaries-as-a-service" SLA to enterprise customers. Expected ARR range $60k-$250k depending on dedicated pool sizing.

Risks / blockers: Legal wants retention controls + EU residency addendum; engineering wants a dedicated pool for sustained throughput (holiday spikes); cost sensitivity noted — pushing back on per-minute pricing if concurrency required.
